title: about the CPU chart box: draging arround is glitchy. a dont see where I can drag them to hide?
fix: Fixed CPU widget drag-and-drop UX in templates/cpu.html: (1) Replaced native glitchy DnD with a placeholder-based drag preview and drag-mode toggle—dragging is now enabled only after clicking the '✋ Drag' button to avoid accidental drags. (2) Replaced ambiguous '⋮⋮' handles with a clear '☰' drag handle, hover highlight, and opacity/cursor feedback. (3) Added a '👁 Manage' button that opens a widget manager modal where each widget can be shown/hidden; hidden state persists to localStorage alongside pinned/saved state. (4) Added per-widget '🙈' hide buttons and persisted hidden/minimized states. (5) Reset now clears order, pinned, hidden, minimized, and drag-mode keys and reloads. Charts remain rendered after reorder because only the widget cards move, not their internal content.
